title: Chaco Cultural Heritage Area Protection Act of 2018
short_title: Chaco Cultural Heritage Area Protection Act of 2018

actions.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources.
Committee on Energy and Natural Resources Subcommittee on Public Lands, Forests, and Mining. Hearings held. With printed Hearing: S.Hrg. 115-528.

latest_action.text: Committee on Energy and Natural Resources Subcommittee on Public Lands, Forests, and Mining. Hearings held. With printed Hearing: S.Hrg. 115-528.

summaries.text:
Chaco Cultural Heritage Area Protection Act of 2018
 This bill withdraws the federal lands and interests that are within the Chaco Cultural Heritage Withdrawal Area in New Mexico and any land or interest within such area which is acquired by the federal government after enactment of this bill from:
 entry, appropriation, and disposal under the public land laws;
 location, entry, and patent under mining laws; and 
 operation of the mineral leasing, mineral materials, and geothermal leasing laws.
